Name: Secret Woods Totoro (Ghibli) (CP)
Author: LorSnore
Description:
[size=2]Replaces Old Master Cannoli [b]graphics [/b]and[b] text[/b] with Totoro from Ghibli movie [i]My Neighbor Totoro[/i]. Seasonal graphics, and a big smile-yelling mouth to show gratitude when you gift the Sweet Gem Berry![/size]


[size=3][u]Configuration[/u][/size]
[size=2]After loading the mod once, you can set the winter leaf pile to "Dead"(default) or "Blue" in the config.json[/size]


[size=3][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
[size=3]- [/size][size=2]Edits only the graphical area of the statue in the seasonal outdoorsTileSheet, and only the single text line in Strings/Locations via Content Patcher, so no compatibility issues should arise![/size]
[size=3]- [/size][size=2]Install by downloading, unzipping, and dragging the unzipped folder to your Mods folder, the same one where you installed Content Patcher. Can be easily uninstalled by removing it from your Mods folder[/size]
